Recruitment Coordinator at Acteon Group Ltd.

UTEC, part of Acteon Group, is one of the world's largest independent offshore and onshore survey providers. We provide a wide range of survey, positioning and data management services using the most advanced equipment and techniques. The data we generate provides our clients with the information they need to make critical, well informed, business decisions.


UTEC is looking to add an Associate Project Surveyor to the team. The Associate Project Surveyor will support the provision of technical survey expertise, assisting Project Surveyors and the Survey Manager in the safe and profitable execution of assigned projects. They will help facilitate communication between all concerned parties, including customers, suppliers, and both onshore and offshore Company staff. The Associate Project Surveyor will contribute to the ongoing monitoring and improvement of procedures to help ensure quality results are consistently achieved.


The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.


**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Support the management of the project lifecycle, assisting with planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout phases, including post-completion review
  • Contribute to project risk assessments prior to mobilization under the guidance of senior staff
  • Assist in reviewing and transferring project material from the bid stage to project teams, including contract requirements, technical specifications, and commercial terms
  • Support project execution and assist in identifying, documenting, and escalating contractual variations
  • Help coordinate personnel requirements for projects in collaboration with Operations Management
  • Assist in sourcing project equipment internally and externally to support execution
  • Help identify and report potential technical, commercial, and QHSE risks for assigned projects
  • Administer and assist with specific project tasks as delegated by the Project Surveyor or Survey Manager
  • Follow appropriate procedures, work instructions, and forms within the IMS to support compliance with Company standards
  • Review survey specifications in contract and project documentation with supervision
  • Provide input to commercial and technical proposals as requested
  • Assist in compiling project-specific survey procedures aligned with Company operating procedures
  • Collaborate with other disciplines to support the development of high-quality technical content for commercial and project support
  • Stay informed on relevant technical developments, working practices, and Company procedures
  • Provide technical support to offshore teams when required, under supervision
  • Assist in quality control and contribute to the timely delivery of final reports
  • Participate in project risk assessments before mobilization
  • Support quality control of final deliverables to clients
  • Assist in liaising with internal logistics personnel to help coordinate offshore staff and equipment mobilization
  • Participate in site and client visits as required, under supervision
  • Follow appropriate procedures, work instructions, and forms within the Integrated Management System (IMS) to support compliance with Company standards
  • Actively participate in the Company's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) programs, including safety meetings and operational risk assessments, as requested
  • Support the execution of operations in alignment with the Health, Safety, and Environmental Management System, ensuring safe and compliant practices
  • Actively participate in the Company's Quality and HSE Systems and Procedures, demonstrating safe working practices and a commitment to continuous improvement
  • Understand and comply with UTEC policies and procedures, particularly those related to health, safety, and environmental standards


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Surveying, Geoscience, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Experience in the offshore survey industry is desirable
  • Must be team-oriented, possess a positive attitude, and work well with others in a collaborative environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel is essential; familiarity with other Microsoft Office applications is beneficial
  • Ability to perform tasks with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Willingness to learn how to professionally present project materials and engage with clients under supervision
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and contribute effectively within project teams
  • Must hold a valid passport free from restrictions that would prevent travel to countries where the Company operates
  • Basic understanding of HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) principles, including risk assessment and safety standards, with a commitment to ongoing development in this area

Descrição da vaga
Somos a Rede Américas, a rede de assistência à saúde multiplataforma , que tem o propósito de oferecer o cuidado completo na medida certa para a saúde.
Estamos em busca de talentos que acreditam que é possível oferecer a melhor e mais avançada assistência à saúde.
Se você tem paixão por cuidar e acredita na medicina de qualidade, vem ser Rede Américas!
Temos um compromisso com a Diversidade!
Incentivamos a candidatura de todos que reconhecem a importância da construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, assédio e discriminação. Juntos entregamos o nosso melhor sempre.
Importante: não efetuamos cobranças de taxas em nossos processos seletivos.
 Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responder tecnicamente pela Instituição perante o Conselho Regional de Farmácia e Vigilância Sanitária local;
  • Manter contato regular com as equipes cirúrgicas para estabelecer rotinas padronizadas para montagem de kits personalizados;
  • Treinar e capacitar a equipe de farmácia a desempenhar as atividades pertinentes a cada função do setor de farmácia;
  • Definir os padrões e mecanismos de controle para gerenciamento dos produtos consignados;
  • Monitorar o gerenciamento de medicamentos de alto risco, sujeitos a controle especial;
  • Supervisionar a conferência e o ressuprimento dos carros de emergência das unidades;
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas dos ambientes das farmácias, visando manter um ambiente limpo e organizado;
  • Supervisionar a manipulação dos medicamentos, observando as Boas Práticas de Preparação, a fim de que os medicamentos sejam disponibilizados na dose, volume e diluição corretos, de acordo com a necessidade dos pacientes, mitigando riscos de contaminação microbiológica;
  • Garantir que todos os medicamentos sejam transferidos entre as unidades e dispensados corretamente no sistema, evitando erro de faturamento e dispersão;
  • Controlar a estabilidade dos medicamentos, adotando os procedimentos técnicos necessários, para evitar perdas desnecessárias de medicamentos e armazená-los com segurança;
  • Supervisionar as investigações de Farmacovigilâcia e Tecnovigilância e fazer análise crítica dos dados obtidos;
  • Supervisionar controle de folhas de sala;
  • Realizar inventários sempre que necessário.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Curso superior completo em Farmácia;
  • Cursos Complementares/Certificações: Pós-graduação completa em farmácia hospitalar e/ou clínica;
  • Desejável: MBA em gestão ou mestrado na área de atuação;
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Farmácia;
  • Conhecimento de Farmacologia, Farmácia clínica, farmacovigilância e Farmácia Hospitalar;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão da qualidade, legislação aplicada á Farmácia e acompanhamento de indicadores de resultados;
  • Conhecimento desejável: Logística/Gestão de Estoques/ Cadeia de suprimentos hospitalares;
  • Experiência no uso de sistema de gestão hospitalares (MV, WPD, SISOSP ou Tasy);
  • Vivência com certificações voltadas para qualidade.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Purpose
Howard University is seeking an innovative and collaborative Executive Director of Financial Aid to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for the Office of Financial Aid. The Executive Director is responsible for ensuring the successful administration of all institutional, federal, state, local, and private financial aid and scholarship programs. The Executive Director is responsible for accurate and efficient financial aid processing, operations, and customer service while ensuring compliance with all applicable federal laws, regulations, institutional policies and procedures, and donor restrictions. The Executive Director plays a key role in supporting the University's enrollment, retention, and net tuition revenue goals through the development and implementation of effective financial aid strategies. As a member of the Enrollment Management Leadership Team, the Executive Director collaborates closely with other units within Enrollment Management and Student Success, colleges/schools and academic departments, Development and Alumni Relations, and other administrative and student services units. A critical partnership exists with the Office of the Bursar, with whom the Executive Director works directly to ensure seamless coordination of student billing, outside scholarship and third-party payments, aid disbursement, and student account resolution.
Nature And Scope
The Executive Director is also responsible for promoting a student-centered culture by educating students and their families about college financing options, empowering them to make informed financial decisions. The role includes fostering professional development among staff and cultivating a service-oriented environment focused on student success.
Supervisory Accountability
Responsible for general oversight of Financial Aid Team Members.
Principal Accountabilities
  • Serve as University’s Chief Financial Aid Administrator for Title IV, Title VII, and Institutional Aid.
  • Monitor and analyze federal Title IV, Title VII and Title IX, NCAA, state, institutional and other applicable regulations to guide and coordinate necessary financial aid policy, system and procedural changes for the Office of Financial Aid and the University in general.
  • Collaborate with the Vice President for Enrollment Management to develop annual financial aid budgets, policies, and procedures that support enrollment and strategic plan objectives.
  • Responsible for leveraging the University’s institutional aid programs to support enrollment, net tuition revenue, and comply with budgetary needs of the University. Specifically responsible for supporting recruitment and retention efforts through strategic assessment and leveraging of financial aid programs.
  • Serve as key administrator within Enrollment Management. Collaborate with other Enrollment Management units to create streamlined student enrollment experience.
  • Work with University leadership on all issues concerning Financial Aid.
  • Review and submit the University’s annual Fiscal Operations Report and Application to Participate (FISAP), Program Participation Agreement (PPA) and Eligibility and Certification Approval report (ECAR).
  • Act as primary Financial Aid contact for compliance and financial audits and reviews.
  • Conduct formal and ad hoc training sessions for entire Financial Aid staff and cross functional training for other areas of the Office of Financial Aid.
  • Represent the University and the Office of Financial Aid at internal and external events and respond verbally and in writing to inquiries regarding service delivery, audits, administrative functions and daily operations.
  • Responsible for final financial aid appeals from students.
  • Counsel current and prospective students and parents on all federal, state and institutional student aid programs and on procedures related to receiving financial aid.
  • Maintain accurate and properly documented financial aid records in compliance with federal, state, local and institutional guidelines and regulations.
  • Stay current with evolving federal and state regulations through ongoing research and participation in professional development opportunities.
  • Supervise the management of the student aid system, including data integrity, compliance reporting, timely disbursement, reconciliation of funds, and audit preparation.
  • Work directly with the Bursar's Office to coordinate financial aid disbursement, student billing, and account resolution processes.
  • Develop and maintain a student-centric culture of customer service, ensuring that students and families are well-informed about financial aid processes and college financing options.
  • Provide outreach and education on financial literacy and aid options through various channels, including workshops, digital content, and one-on-one counseling.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
  • Demonstrated success working without supervision, taking considerable initiative, collaboratively setting, and attaining performance goals, and managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines
  • Committed to providing quality assistance to a socio-economically diverse student population
  • Demonstrated ability to provide innovative responsiveness to problem-solving within a team environment
  • Process-oriented and able to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Can exercise good judgment when faced with difficult decisions
  • Expert knowledge of financial aid program legislation as well as internal and external reporting requirements.
  • Experience with an automated financial system.
  • Skill in the operation of computers, related software applications and standard office equipment, in a timely, accurate and efficient manner.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with students, staff, faculty, and the general public.
  • Proficient in using CRM and ERP technology. Workday Studenta and PowerFAIDs experience preferred.
  • Strong customer service skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and attention to detail are essential
  • Excellent interpersonal skills including the ability to listen and communicate in a professional and positive manner
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with students, staff, faculty, and the public
Minimum Requirements
  • Masters required.
  • 10+ years progressively responsible supervisory experience in financial aid
  • Strong understanding of the admissions and financial aid processes, financial aid leveraging, and optimization of financial aid for strategic enrollment
  • Experience in developing and implementing strategic initiatives and planning financial literacy programming
  • Skill in leading and managing a results-oriented team of financial aid professionals
  • Professional written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively present information to a wide range of constituents, including senior organizational leaders, public groups, and people from diverse cultures and worldviews
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and other basic technology
  • Expert knowledge of the financial aid modules of an ERP system.
Work Environment
  • In person
  • On Howard University main campus
  • 40 hours per week, generally Monday through Friday, weekends, and evenings as necessary

Expected Salary Range: $150,000 - $175,000

Description

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

Description
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich, the Senior Event Controller will drive in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Assist with the preparation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027budget, for the period , which captures all the operational costs to ensure the successful delivery of the tournament.
  • Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands-on training with the budget owners in Brazil.
  • Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget.
  • Lead in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based).
  • Work closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets.
  • Present the outcome of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders.
  • Coordinate the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 Accounting teams and the various budget owners.
  • Review monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required.
  • Prepare monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management.
  • Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • Experience in an event organization in a financial role (organizing major sport events or other similar projects).
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with budgeting and reporting tools.
  • Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi-entity environment.
  • Experience in an international environment.
  • Experience in procurement of advantage.
  • SAP experience preferred.
  • Well-developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines.
  • Business fluent in English, any other language is an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering.
  • Have a proactive hands-on approach to problem solving - a 'can do' attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Well-versed in Microsoft Office Excel, Word & Powerpoint presentation.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

A Stone
Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.
Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.
Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.
Nossa Cultura
A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.
Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.
A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.
Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
Como é Ser Um(a) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Inbound)
Você será responsável por realizar vendas consultivas de forma receptiva, conectando as necessidades do(a) cliente às nossas soluções financeiras, com foco em um atendimento de excelência.
Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá gerir as vendas por meio dos nossos canais de atendimento (chat, WhatsApp e telefone), garantindo agilidade e assertividade.
O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência prévia com vendas (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas.
O Que Aumenta Suas Chances
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Interesse em se especializar na área de vendas.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo
Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
Apresentação Pessoal: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário e encaminhar um vídeo com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies e motivações e sonhos.
Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

title: Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction
description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

  • Cargo Superintendent (See Unit HSEP Shipboard Manual Organization Chart for local variations)

Background

  • The Cargo Supervisor will exhibit a high standard of leadership, supervisory and safety behaviors and will ensure that all aspects of Cargo and Cargo Utility systems operations and supervision are carried out effectively. Delegated tasks will be monitored and controlled formally and effectively.
  • Equivalent to Ballast Control Operator (BCO) as per Res. A.1079(28) Reg. 6.4

Authority

  • The Cargo Supervisor assumes delegated authority for marine activities such as cargo loading and offloading and cargo utilities and maintenance. He or she will work with the Cargo Superintendent and the OIM as required where the safety of the crew and vessel is concerned. Work authority is delegated to competent personnel as appropriate.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Cargo Operations
  • 1 Prepare to Start Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 2 Startup Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 3 Monitor and Maintain Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 4 Prepare and shutdown Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 5 Contribute to Tank Entry, Inspection and Maintenance Activities
  • 2) Manage And Supervise Effectively
  • 1 Demonstrate leadership in technical and safety issues.
  • 2 Liaise effectively with all relevant onshore and offshore departments.
  • 3 Delegate authority having due regard for competence and verify effective close out of tasks.
  • 4 Promote training and competency assurance throughout the department in line with Company goals for the Unit.
  • 5 Promote safety awareness and application of the Management System regarding immediate safety of personnel (PTW/Risk assessments/inspections).
  • 6 Ensure timely and effective close-out of relevant survey and audit action items.
  • 7 Encourage and support all department personnel to achieve training and competency targets and plan for appropriate time allocation for this area of work.
  • 8 Ensure timely and effective contributions to reporting and investigation of all incidents where required.
  • 3) Contribute To The Control Of Critical Situations And Respond To Emergencies
  • 1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc.) are identified and positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative
  • 2 Manage emergency response with due regard for safety of personnel, FSO/FPSO and environment
  • 3 Demonstrate knowledge and awareness of potential emergency scenarios.
  • 4 Contribute to the effective de-brief and analysis of exercises.
  • 4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  • 2 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

Offshore - Perform Lifeboat Maintenance

Offshore - Manage Supply and Crew Boat Operations

Offshore - Monitor Weather Condition

Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge

Offshore - Crane operations, rigging and lifting operations

Offshore - Safety Management - HOD

Offshore - Define Hull Integrity Management

Offshore - Tanker Terminal

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum qualifications as per STCW II/2 Chief Officer of ships of 3000gt or more.
  • 3 years Crude Oil tankers experience (VLCC preferable) as OOW (Officer on Watch) Chief Officer experience desirable.
  • Previous FPSO experience would be an advantage.
  • Use and experience with Loading Computer Software.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore

A nossa missão desde então é fazer com que as pessoas reflitam sobre os seus hábitos.
E não apenas os hábitos relacionados à mobilidade urbana.
Queremos que as pessoas olhem mais ao seu redor.
Como você leva a sua vida?
Qual é a sua relação com a natureza, com o tempo, com o seu trabalho, família e amigos?
A nossa marca não é apenas sobre bicicletas elétricas.
A Lev é sobre escolhas, como escolher o caminho mais bonito em vez do mais rápido.
E por falar em caminho, que ele seja sempre a melhor parte.
Muito prazer, nós somos a Lev.

title: Analista de Faturamento Sênior Rio de Janeiro - RJ and Hybrid Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade éa sua chance. Nessa posição deAnalista de Faturamento Sênior,você vai somar ao time Finanças que tem comoobjetivo Garantir a assertividade da receita bem como as rotinas de Faturamento e Contas a Receber.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Garantir que as áreas especialistas tenham conhecimento dos insumos necessários para o reconhecimento da receita (competência, valor das campanhas, pedidos de inserção, etc.), por meio de reuniões semanais;
  • Garantir a aderência ao cronograma de faturamento, com reuniões semanais para cumprimento dos prazos da empresa;
  • Garantir a assertividade na contabilização da provisão de receita, faturamento e ajustes, acompanhando relatórios sistêmicos e gerenciais;
  • Executar as rotinas de faturamento e contas a receber (receita nacional e internacional), acompanhando e ajustando os prazos e prioridades estipulados pela empresa;
  • Atuar nas renegociações dos contratos da área de Faturamento;
  • Apoiar as demandas da auditoria interna e externa;
  • Acompanhar e atuar de forma proativa nas metas (OKR), através de solicitações e implantações de melhorias em sistemas e processos (integração da receita de vendas online para o ERP, implantação da ferramenta de conciliação de recebimentos, enriquecimento da base do ERP com informações da receita por vertical, etc.);
  • Elaborar e atualizar os arquivos com relatórios da área (Taxa de Conversão, Prazo Médio de Recebimento, Receita por Vertical, etc.);
  • Garantir o fechamento mensal da receita e realizar as validações necessárias para assegurar que as informações financeiras sejam refletidas de forma integral no balanço;

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Atuação com área Administrativa e/ou Financeira;
  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em áreas de Exatas (Economia, Contabilidade, Administração, Engenharia, Atuária, etc.);
  • Experiência: Faturamento, contas a receber, garantia de receita e conhecimento em processos de reconhecimento de receita e recebíveis;
  • Ferramentas: Domínio do Pacote Office e sistemas ERP;
  • De 4 a 6 anos de experiencia em Faturamento.

O que será um diferencial?

  • Pós-graduação: Desejável especialização (MBA, Mestrado, Doutorado) em Finanças.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: NOC Leader
description:
Ceragon (NASDAQ: CRNT) is a global innovator and leading solutions provider of end-to-end wireless connectivity, specializing in transport, access, and AI-powered managed & professional services. We empower customers to enhance operational efficiency and enrich end-user experience through our innovative solutions.

Our clients include service providers, utilities, public safety organizations, government agencies, energy companies, and more. They rely on our expertise in 5G & 4G broadband wireless connectivity, mission-critical services, and applications leveraging ultra-high reliability and speed. Ceragon solutions are deployed by over 600 service providers and 1,600 private network owners across more than 130 countries.

Our end-to-end solutions, encompassing hardware, software, and managed & professional services, enable customers to confidently adopt future wireless technologies, shaping next-generation connectivity and service delivery. Ceragon offers reliable, rapid-deployment, high-capacity wireless solutions for diverse communication network use cases, designed to lower TCO by minimizing spectrum, power, real estate, and labor resources—facilitating quick, cost-effective network modernization and establishing Ceragon as a leading provider in the "connectivity everywhere" era.

Position is located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil .

We are seeking a qualified NoC Team Leader to join our team. The role involves coordinating and overseeing the front office team to ensure optimal network operation and managed service delivery, along with efficient workflow management.

Your key duties and responsibilities include:

  • Setting clear team goals and KPIs aligned with customer SLA commitments.
  • Organizing and assigning tasks to NoC team members.
  • Monitoring team performance during shifts to ensure smooth operations and timely, accurate task completion.
  • Handling network outage crises and applying appropriate crisis management strategies.
  • Conducting performance evaluations and providing feedback to team members.
  • Creating a motivating and healthy work environment.
  • Monitoring team performance metrics and reporting on them.
  • Identifying training needs and coaching team members accordingly.
  • Gathering feedback and resolving issues or conflicts within the team.
  • Providing network and audit reports related to network operations and team performance.
  • Identifying opportunities for improvement and acting on them.

description:

Responsabilidades Da Posição
A Drogaria Venancio busca um Assistente de Contas a Receber para se juntar à nossa equipe financeira . Nossa equipe é dinâmica e inovadora , e estamos procurando por alguém que compartilhe nossa paixão por excelência . Como Assistente de Contas a Receber, você será responsável por recebimentos de valores , apuração de valores e realização de encontro de contas .
Se você é uma pessoa organizada , detalhista e com experiência em contas a receber, nós queremos ouvir de você ! Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e oportunidades de crescimento .
Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Experiência em contas a receber - Mínimo de 1 ano
  • Comunicação eficaz - Para lidar com clientes e equipe interna
  • Organização e planejamento - Para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas
Sobre a Empresa
Cuidando de você, sempre!
Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e ao mesmo tempo mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda.
Além disso, nossos canais digitais ampliam nossa atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.
Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além dos medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.
Em 2014, criamos a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e na distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo um serviço especializado e eficiente. Para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição, estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.
O que nos torna únicos? Nossa essência carioca, o acolhimento genuíno e a busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e ganhamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importante.
A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.
Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer com a gente!

Talent Acquisition Partner @ Amagi I SaaS GTM Recruiting I MediaTech I AdTech I OTT I CTV

Amagi is a market leader in cloud-based media technology services for channel creation, distribution, and ad monetization. Amagi's cloud technology and managed services are used by TV networks, content owners, and CTV / OTT platforms to create 24x7 linear channels for OTT and broadcast distribution. Amagi delivers unified cloud solutions for channel creation, distribution, and advertisement via its lineup of versatile products, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM.

Amagi's pioneering and market-leading cloud platform has won numerous accolades and is deployed in over 40 countries by 600+ TV networks. Customers of Amagi include A+E Networks, Comcast, Cox Media Group, Google, NBC Universal, Roku, Samsung, Warner Media, and many more.

This role provides a unique and transformative opportunity to grow a world-class technology organization by innovating how content is originated, distributed, and monetized. Amagi has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, New Delhi, and Bangalore.

About The Role

As a Sr. Systems Engineer at Amagi, you will serve as a trusted advisor to our broadcast customers, leveraging your deep expertise in broadcast engineering and streaming technologies to address customer challenges and drive adoption of Amagi's cloud-based media technology solutions. You will be responsible for the technical aspects of the pre-sales process, ensuring seamless integration and alignment of our products with customer needs, while representing Amagi's innovative broadcast solutions in the market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Act as the primary technical resource for the sales team, providing expert guidance on broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, distribution, and streaming technologies
  • Solution Design & POCs: Collaborate with clients to understand their broadcast and streaming needs, design tailored solutions, and create customer-focused Proofs of Concept (POCs) with clearly defined success criteria
  • Pre-Sales Support: Lead technical discussions during the pre-sales process, including gathering customer requirements, conducting technical demos, and responding to Requests for Proposals (RFPs). Manage technical customer engagement and ensure a smooth handoff to the onboarding team
  • Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Amagi's products and services, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM, to build and deliver curated demos, technical presentations, and training materials
  • Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a technical advisor and ensuring their long-term success with Amagi's broadcast solutions
  • Industry Engagement: Represent Amagi at trade shows, conferences, and technical forums, demonstrating our product capabilities and staying current with industry trends and best practices
  • Feedback & Development: Gather and communicate client feedback to the product development team, helping to influence product enhancements and ensuring our solutions meet market demands.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Manage Pre-Sales Engagements: Oversee multiple customer opportunities and related projects, prioritizing work and proactively escalating risks in consultation with the manager and sales teams
  • Single Point of Contact: Serve as the main technical contact for customers during the pre-sales process, engaging subject matter experts (SMEs) as needed for complex discussions or architecture reviews
  • Discovery & Documentation: Participate in discovery calls, accurately document customer requirements, and create technical Statements of Work (SOWs) for proposed solutions
  • Product Gap Analysis: Identify product gaps, create internal cases, and collaborate with the product team on feature requests and prioritization
  • Escalation Support: Provide technical support during customer escalations and collaborate with global internal teams during non-working hours if needed
  • Content Development: Develop technical collateral, including blog posts, training materials, and demos, to support internal and external enablement efforts
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly provide feedback to enhance the pre-sales engineering process and improve product and technical documentation

Requirements

Education : Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant experience.

Experience : 7+ years in media & entertainment technologies, with 5+ years in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or broadcast engineering.

MUST have Technical Skills :

  • Subject matter expertise in broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, and distribution workflows
  • Strong understanding of streaming media technologies and ad monetization
  • Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., AWS, GCP) and tools such as Linux, automation tools (e.g., Pulumi, Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible), scripting languages (e.g., Ruby, Python), workflows (e.g., Argo CI/CD, GitOps), or containerized services (e.g., Kubernetes) is desirable
  • Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with sales and software engineering tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence
  • Language Skills: Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory; proficiency in Spanish is a plus
  • Communication Skills: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely in written and verbal form, including technical instructions and product descriptions
  • Problem-Solving & Time Management: Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving client challenges. Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, with excellent multitasking and time management skills

Additional Requirements

  • Must have worked with a broadcast vendor or a customer in broadcast engineering
  • Knowledge of broadcast operations is highly desirable
  • Professional certifications in public cloud technologies are a plus
  • No visa sponsorship or moving allowance is available

Why Join Amagi?

  • Innovative Environment: Be part of Amagi's story at the forefront of cloud-based broadcast and streaming technology innovation
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement in a rapidly growing industry
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a passionate team dedicated to delivering success for our clients and driving innovation in the media technology space

title: Analista de Segurança Eletrônica - Data Centers
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, enabling connectivity to foster innovations that enrich our work, life, and planet.

We welcome bold ideas, value human connection, and offer opportunities for everyone to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the forefront of shaping the future and enhancing customer value through innovation. You will collaborate across teams, influence decisions, and help define the path forward. Join us to find belonging, purpose, and a supportive team — because when you feel valued, you can do your best work.

Resumo da Posição

A equipe de Segurança Eletrônica é responsável por fornecer suporte técnico e operacional diário às operações de segurança física dos data centers, garantindo atendimento às metas de desempenho relacionadas à satisfação do cliente, disponibilidade, responsabilidade fiscal, capacidade de resposta e trabalho em equipe. Essa posição trabalha colaborativamente com diversas áreas internas e externas, como Cyber Security, Global Risk, IBX Operations, Design & Construction, Sales, Customer Care, entre outras, para atender às necessidades de segurança física e conformidade da empresa.

Responsabilidades

Ordens de Serviço

  • Apoiar instalações e desinstalações de segurança de complexidade moderada.
  • Gerenciar solicitações de trabalho não padronizadas, internas e externas, incluindo coordenação com fornecedores.
  • Acompanhar pedidos de segurança de clientes, incluindo requisitos de relatórios e auditorias.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e distribuição de RFPs para projetos de infraestrutura de segurança.
  • Coordenar equipamentos auxiliares e realizar pequenos reparos para minimizar tempo de inatividade.

Gestão de Incidentes

  • Responder a incidentes de segurança no local de complexidade moderada.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e análises de causa raiz.
  • Aplicar a matriz de decisão de incidentes de segurança e coordenar com o Equinix Operations Center (EOC).

Manutenção de Infraestrutura

  • Resolver problemas moderados relacionados ao sistema de controle de acesso (ACS) e sistema de gerenciamento de vídeo (VMS).
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva conforme procedimentos operacionais padrão.
  • Atender solicitações de suporte ao cliente, como auditorias e pedidos personalizados de segurança.
  • Gerenciar inventário de ativos e endereços IP de equipamentos de segurança.

Gestão de Fornecedores

  • Apoiar trabalhos de fornecedores relacionados a projetos de segurança voltados ao cliente e infraestrutura interna.
  • Coordenar com a equipe de gestão do site para atender requisitos de auditorias internas e externas.

Administração do Site

  • Garantir conformidade com processos e procedimentos de segurança e iniciativas de controle de qualidade.
  • Analisar e manter desenhos e documentação de suporte específicos do site.

Colaboração

  • Apoiar stakeholders durante atividades de manutenção.
  • Comunicar-se com equipes para coordenar instalações de segurança que impactam a infraestrutura.
  • Colaborar na implementação e validação de atualizações de sistemas.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multifuncionais em novas construções e expansões.

Requisitos

  • Vivência prática em instalação e manutenção de sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, com conhecimento técnico em cabeamento estruturado, redes IP e eletrônica aplicada à segurança física.
  • Experiência consolidada em ambientes operacionais, com atuação direta em projetos de infraestrutura de segurança.
  • Conhecimento substancial em procedimentos operacionais padrão de segurança física.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas moderadamente complexos com julgamento e autonomia.
  • Habilidade para colaborar com diversas áreas e comunicar-se de forma eficaz.
  • Comunicação e compreensão do Idioma inglês será considerado um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencialmente nos Data Centers da Equinix em São Paulo e Barueri.

Equinix está comprometida em garantir que nosso processo de recrutamento seja acessível a todos, incluindo pessoas com deficiência. Se você é um candidato qualificado e necessita de assistência ou acomodação, por favor, informe-nos preenchendo este formulário .

A Equinix é uma empregadora que promove a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego e, nos EUA, uma empregadora de Ação Afirmativa. Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, origem étnica, nacionalidade, sexo, gravidez, condições médicas relacionadas, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estado civil, status de veterano ou militar, deficiência física ou mental, informações genéticas, filiação política/organizacional, condição de vítima ou familiar de vítima de crime ou abuso, ou qualquer outra condição protegida por lei aplicável.
